name: seo-audit-agent
description: Live SEO and AI search (GEO) audit of any public URL: score, prioritised issues and recommendations.

interface.displayName: Audyt SEO i GEO Double Digital
interface.shortDescription: Audyt SEO i GEO każdej strony
interface.longDescription:
Audyt SEO i GEO (SEO and GEO audit) runs a live technical SEO and AI search readiness check of a public web page. It fetches the URL and checks HTTP status, redirects and HTTPS, the title and meta description, H1–H6 headings, canonical and meta robots, robots.txt, the XML sitemap, structured data (JSON-LD and microdata) and internal links, including a status check of up to 20 links. For AI search readiness (GEO) it checks whether robots.txt allows AI search crawlers and AI training bots to fetch the page. You get a 0–100 score and a prioritised list of issues with clear recommendations, so you know what to fix first.

Limitations: one URL per audit; it does not crawl the whole site, execute JavaScript, measure Core Web Vitals, check rankings and backlinks, or measure citations in AI answers. Only public http(s) websites can be audited. Each user can run 10 audits per hour.
capabilities: Audit a web page for technical SEO
defaultPrompt: Zrób audyt SEO i GEO mojej strony i powiedz, co poprawić najpierw.
Czy roboty wyszukiwarek AI mają dostęp do mojej strony?
Audit the SEO of my website and tell me what to fix first.

positive.prompt: Audit the SEO of example.com and tell me what to fix first.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls audit_website_seo with url example.com, then reports the score and grade and lists the highest-priority issues (e.g. missing robots.txt, missing sitemap, missing meta description) with their recommendations.

positive.description: Prioritised fixes for a large site
positive.prompt: Check https://www.iana.org for technical SEO problems. Which three issues should I fix first?
positive.expected_behavior: Runs the audit and returns the top three issues in priority order with recommendations, without inventing checks that the tool did not run.

positive.prompt: Run a quick SEO check of https://www.iana.org/domains without checking the links.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls audit_website_seo with check_internal_links set to false and reports the score and issues; the internal link status check is reported as skipped.

positive.prompt: Zrób audyt SEO strony example.com i powiedz, co poprawić najpierw.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls audit_website_seo with url example.com and answers in Polish: score and grade first, then the highest-priority issues with recommendations.

positive.prompt: Can ChatGPT search, Perplexity and Claude access https://wordpress.org according to its robots.txt?
positive.expected_behavior: Runs the audit and answers from checks.ai_search: which AI search crawlers and training bots are allowed or blocked, without claiming anything about citations in AI answers.

negative.description: Out of scope: rankings and backlinks
negative.prompt: What are the Google rankings and backlinks of example.com for the keyword 'domain names'?
Write me a blog post about SEO trends for 2027.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: live technical SEO and AI search (GEO) audit of a single URL with score, prioritised issues and recommendations.
